receipt.public_excerpt: DeepSeek V3 delivers 3.5-Sonnet-level results for simple tasks at just 2% of the cost.

evidence_items.explanation: An independent coding-tool maker, reporting user experience, found V3 competitive with Claude 3.5 Sonnet on simple tasks at a small fraction of the price. It also found weaker results on complex work.
R1 cost $0.55 input and $2.19 output per 1M tokens. V3 cost $0.14 and $0.28 at the discount, or $0.27 and $1.10 at full price.
